description: Ganit ki avdharnaayein aur samasya samadhan
Bhautiki, rasayan vigyan aur jeev vigyan sahit vigyan
Nayi bhasha seekhna ya bhasha kaushal mein sudhaar
Aitihasik ghatnaayein, kaal aur pramukh vyakti
Vyaktigat vitt, budget banana aur nivesh ki samajh
Swasthya jaankari ki samajh aur soch-samajhkar swasthya nirnay
Computer aur internet ke buniyadi kaushal
Nagrik shiksha, sarkar ki sanrachna aur nagrik adhikar
Bhugol, naksha aur duniya ki samajh
Hindi sahitya — kavita, kahani aur upanyas
Bhartiya Samvidhan, maulik adhikar aur kartavya
